name: RawTrampis
description:
RawTrampis Pro v4.5.0 is Trampis’ customizable Geometry Dash practice and gameplay toolkit. It combines category-based controls, gameplay assistance, live status tools, keybinds, searchable options, configuration profiles, and a themeable interface. Features are opt-in and remain off unless enabled in their settings.

OPENING, LAYOUT, AND SEARCH
Press Ctrl+N to open or close the menu; the shortcut can be changed in Keybinds. In the tabbed layout, category panels can be dragged by their title bars and their positions are saved when the menu closes. Scroll inside a panel to browse its controls, then use a feature’s settings arrow for its supported options. Search matches feature names, descriptions, and IDs. Matching controls are highlighted while unrelated controls are dimmed, keeping the layout readable; Clear Search restores the normal view.

THEMES AND PRESENTATION
Choose from RawTrampis Blue, Nona, Nona Lux, Octavus, Septima, Sextus, Festive, Genesis, Catppuccin, Mint, Purple Rain, Platypus, Barbie, Navy, Cyanish, 7up, Arctic, Aurora, Cyber, Emerald, Flame, Sunset, Rose, Catppuccin Macchiato, Gruvbox, MegaHack, MegaOverlay, and OpenHack. The theme picker is a scaled, scrollable list with separate main and accent color previews. Switching palettes preserves the current renderer, layout, and panel arrangement. Interface settings include scale, font, spacing, animation, and background blur. Blur is animated with the menu and is available on the desktop ImGui renderer; unsupported renderer/platform combinations keep it disabled safely.

CONFIGURATION PROFILES
Enter a profile name and choose Save Profile to store the current configuration in the mod’s profile folder. Load Profile applies a saved profile and notifies registered feature callbacks so live settings can update. Profile names are limited to safe filename characters. Keep separate practice, recording, or presentation setups without manually reconfiguring each option.

KEYBINDS
Right-click a feature or Shift-click it to manage a supported keybind. Existing bindings show their current key and separate Change Keybind and Remove Keybind actions. Add Keybind makes a feature bindable. In the Keybinds panel, select a binding’s key field and press the desired key combination to confirm; Escape cancels capture. The UI shows the assigned key after capture.

CATEGORIES AND TOOLS
Global contains general gameplay and session controls such as audio, speed, display rate, cursor, lists, and safety options. Level contains level-specific practice, progress, pause, coin, trigger, and visual tools. Player contains Noclip and movement, click, jump, trail, and effect features. Bot provides automation, replay, and practice helpers. Creator contains editor-oriented tools. Labels includes configurable on-screen information and the optional cheat indicator. Shortcuts offers quick actions. Keybinds manages the menu shortcut and supported feature bindings. Interface controls presentation and accessibility. Internal Recorder provides recording and replay controls when its optional integration is present. Options can vary by platform or optional dependencies, and each feature exposes settings when its behavior supports customization.

PRACTICE AND STATUS
Noclip is disabled by default and uses hazard-focused collision handling so ordinary platforms remain solid. The cheat indicator is optional and disabled by default; enable it to display the current indicator. Supported features provide relevant controls such as keybinds, thresholds, modes, display behavior, and gameplay conditions. Simple visual toggles do not need extra settings. Assisted gameplay may change movement, timing, progression, or displayed results; use it where permitted, and do not assume assisted attempts qualify for records or leaderboards.

COMPATIBILITY
The current target is Geometry Dash 2.2081 with Geode 5.11.2. Game, Geode, graphics-driver, or third-party mod updates can affect compatibility.
